Retrieves all organizations configured for a tenant in the EASM Admin Portal
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1/organizations

Retrieves all organizations configured for a tenant in the EASM Admin Portal. To learn more, see Creating & Managing Organizations

Request
​
HEADER PARAMETERS
Authorization
string
REQUIRED

API authentication token

Default value: Bearer your-token
Responses
​
200
401
500

OK
